# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.27

Workflow-stage reporting and full Patient + RX transfer export candidate dated
2026-07-26.

## RX process visibility

- The RX Action Report distinguishes **Next Pending Stage** from
  **Completed Stage**.
- Completed-stage filtering can be combined with Stage Activity From/To dates;
  all selected criteria must match the same workflow completion record.
- Each RX row shows its current completed stage, completion date, completion
  user, and an expandable ordered history of all completed stages.
- CSV and Excel exports include current-stage details plus the complete ordered
  stage/date/user history.

## Full Patient + RX transfer export

- Patient Reports now provide explicit Full CSV and Full Excel actions.
- Patient filters are applied before export.
- Each active RX is a separate vertical row. A patient with multiple RX records
  is repeated on multiple rows with an RX row/count field for clarity.
- A patient without RX remains in the export once, with blank RX fields.
- The export includes patient demographics and assignments, RX dates and
  assignments, medications, warehouse status, workflow state/history, patient
  notes history, and patient service-date history.
- Normal Patient and RX screens remain paginated; this intentionally complete
  transfer query runs only when an administrator requests it.
- The complete export endpoint enforces the Reports Export permission on the
  server as well as disabling the UI action for unauthorized roles.

## Validation

- Complete staging smoke suite passed.
- Isolated Chromium workflow passed, including both new report downloads and
  workflow stage/date filtering.
- PostgreSQL report parity proved vertical multi-RX rows, blank-RX patient rows,
  exact completed-stage/date matching, and ordered stage history.
- Existing Call Center, softphone, role boundary, packaging, restore safety,
  public JavaScript, and database lifecycle regressions passed.

## Database impact

No schema migration and no business-data rewrite. The feature is read-only and
does not change proxy routes, origins, ports, authentication, PBX settings, or
RX Softphone 0.6.0.
